{"draft": "Ametek Q4 2025: Record Sales and Earnings Close the Year
Record fourth-quarter sales and adjusted earnings capped a strong year, with both operating segments contributing double-digit sales growth.

Fourth-quarter sales climbed to a record $2.0 billion, up 13% from a year earlier, while adjusted earnings reached a record $2.01 per diluted share. On a GAAP basis, earnings were $1.73 per diluted share. GAAP operating income was $505.5 million, and adjusted operating income rose to $523.0 million, up 12% versus the prior-year quarter.

Electronic Instruments Group sales increased to a record $1.37 billion, up 13%, with adjusted operating income of $413.7 million. Electromechanical Group sales grew to $628.9 million, up 15%, as operating income jumped to $142.5 million and operating margins reached 22.7%, supporting broad-based profitability across the portfolio.

Cash generation was a standout, with operating cash flow hitting a record $584.3 million and free cash flow reaching a record $527.3 million, representing free cash flow to net income conversion of 132%. For the full year, sales totaled $7.4 billion, providing a solid base heading into the new year.

Outlook: For 2026, sales are expected to be up mid to high single digits compared with 2025, with adjusted earnings per diluted share guided to a range of $7.87 to $8.07. For the first quarter of 2026, sales are expected to climb approximately 10% year over year, with adjusted earnings anticipated at $1.85 to $1.90 per share."}
